title: Quietly Tangy Venezuelan Fish Ceviche
description: A tangy and light Venezuelan dish featuring sashimi-cut fish, perfect for a midnight craving. This recipe is shojin-friendly and uses an egg wash for added richness.
instructions: Cut the halibut fillets into small sashimi-cut pieces and place them in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the lime juice, egg, water, salt, and black pepper to make the egg wash.
Pour the egg wash over the fish pieces and toss to coat.
Add the thinly sliced onion and chopped cilantro to the bowl and toss to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the fish to marinate.
After 30 minutes, remove the bowl from the refrigerator and give the mixture a good stir.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the ceviche chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
